correctness.rationale: The incidence matrix N of a balanced generalized quadrangle satisfies NNᵀ=(q+1)I+A with strongly regular collinearity eigenvalues q(q+1),q−1,−(q+1). The full point/line powered-distance block matrix reduces on the zero-sum subspace to a constant bipartition branch Fq(p), paired L±=(q−1)2^p−q4^p±sqrt(2q)(3^p−1), and null-incidence L0=q4^p−(q+1)2^p. Substituting x=2^p and γ=log_2 3 yields Fsecond(x)>0,Fprime(1)>0 and a unique crossing inside 0<p<log_2(1+1/q). On that interval direct bounds give L0<0 and L±<0, so exactly one centered sector becomes null, giving 2(q+1)(q²+1)−2 embedding dimension. Taylor at p=0, F(0)=−1, F’(0)=q³log(4/3)+O(q²) proves αq∼1/[q³log(4/3)]. I independently computed the spectral formula and noncontrolling-sector signs for q=2,3,5,9,20; the unrestricted result follows from the symbolic inequalities, not those spot checks. Repair: the original RESULT.md had the false exact identity Fq_prime(0)=q³log(4/3)−q(q+1)log(3/2). The corrected full RESULT.md now has Fq_prime(0)=q³log(4/3)−q²log(3/2)+qlog2, exactly equal to differentiating the displayed Fq(p); the q³ leading term and stated O(q^-4) root asymptotic were separately rechecked. This is an actual corrected scientific source byte replacement, not a disclaimer.
